# Aggelos Mouzakitis

> Business and career advisor and BACP-registered psychotherapist. Private 1:1
> work on a specific business, career or personal problem: what is happening
> now, what you want instead, and what is getting in the way. Based in Ireland,
> working online and internationally.

Aggelos Mouzakitis spent 18+ years in product and growth before training as a
psychotherapist: seven years running his own growth consultancy, work with more
than 100 technology companies, a Growth Product Manager role at IBM, and two
startups he built that failed. He holds an MSc in Integrative Counselling &
Psychotherapy (University of Derby), graduate studies in Psychology (The
American College of Greece), and is a registered member of the BACP.

The combination is the point. A pricing problem can involve fear of rejection. A
career decision can be commercially rational and psychologically difficult. So
the work covers both sides when both sides matter, rather than treating every
problem as either a tactic or a feeling.

The method is informed by Jobs to be Done, carried over from years of consumer
research. Four forces decide whether a change happens: what is making the
current situation harder to tolerate (push), what you want instead (pull), what
the current situation still does for you (habit / protection), and what feels
risky about changing (anxiety). Mapping all four decides whether the work is
strategy, skill and decisions, or behaviour, fear and patterns.

## Site structure

There is one paid service — /work-with-me/ — plus a free weekly group format
and a library of free self-assessment tools. Free Tools is the site's primary
call to action. The site is English-only.

- [Home](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/): Positioning, the credentials behind the advice, the before/after changes people come to work on, and the free tools.
- [Work with me](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/work-with-me/): The single 1:1 service. What can be worked on (career and direction, going independent, sales and visibility, business growth, patterns and boundaries, burnout and identity), the Jobs to be Done forces map, fit and not-fit, six common questions, and the free orientation call.
- [About](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/about/): Background and credentials in two columns (business/product/behaviour and psychology/therapy), how consumer research became the way he reads problems, and why he works across both fields.
- [Reviews](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/reviews/): Anonymous client feedback, shared with permission, identifying details removed.
- [Contact](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/contact/): One form. Interests are the free orientation call, WTF Friday, or something else.
- [Confidentiality](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/confidentiality/): How notes and personal data are handled, the limits of confidentiality, plus terms and privacy.

## Free tools

Free, self-scored questionnaires that run in the browser. They are directional
and none of them is a clinical diagnosis.

- [Free Tools](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/free-tools/): The collection, filterable by Business / Career / Psychology.
- [What's limiting your business?](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/free-tools/business-constraint/): 20 questions separating an offer problem from a demand, pricing, conversion or execution problem.
- [Is it a strategy or execution problem?](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/free-tools/strategy-or-execution/): 17 questions separating a wrong plan from a plan that is not being carried out.
- [What's making you want to quit your job?](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/free-tools/quit-your-job/): 20 questions separating the role, the manager, the company, the field and burnout.
- [Do you want to become a solopreneur?](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/free-tools/become-a-solopreneur/): 20 questions separating genuine fit for working alone from wanting out of the current job.
- [Are you burned out?](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/free-tools/burned-out/): 20 questions on exhaustion, cognitive strain, control, boredom, meaning and fit. Directional, not a clinical diagnosis.

## Other pages

- [WTF Friday](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/wtf-friday/): Free weekly group office hours for people working for themselves, or trying to. A group format, not a 1:1 service.
- [Ask me anything](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/ask-me-anything/): Send a question, anonymously if you prefer; selected ones are answered publicly.
- [Therapy for founders](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/therapy-for-founders/): Psychotherapy for founders, with a therapist who has built and advised companies.
- [Therapy for executives](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/therapy-for-executives/): Psychotherapy for senior leaders.
- [Imposter syndrome therapy](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/imposter-syndrome-therapy/): For people who can see the evidence that they are good at their work but cannot feel it.
- [Executive burnout therapy](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/executive-burnout-therapy/): For people who took the break and came back feeling the same.

## Notes

- Professional description: "business and career advisor" and "BACP-registered
  psychotherapist". "Licensed psychotherapist" is not accurate wording for this
  practice and is not used anywhere on the site.
- Verified numbers: 18+ years in product and growth, 7+ years running his own
  consultancy, 100+ technology companies advised, 2 startups built.
- Three former service pages (/psychotherapy-decision-coaching/,
  /career-strategy-consulting/, /solopreneur-growth-consulting/) and the
  /start-here/ orientation flow were consolidated into /work-with-me/ and now
  301 there permanently. The Greek /el/ pages are retired and 301 to the
  English homepage. The five free tools formerly lived under /clarity-tools/;
  those URLs 301 to their /free-tools/ equivalents.
- Canonical host is https://aggelosmouzakitis.com with a trailing slash on every
  page URL.
